summary: Remediated the postmortem to eliminate all blame, establish systemic root cause, and convert all action items to verifiable system and tooling changes.
evidence: Zero individual names referenced throughout the document; all actions attributed to roles and processes.
Systemic root cause rigorously defined around silent exception suppression and transactional decoupling.

Translated all human-behavior 'be more careful' wishes into automated system guarantees (CI config backward-compatibility linter, transactional assertions, domain metric alerting, weekly automated rollback dry-runs).
All action items contain specific owner roles, strict deadlines, and concrete definitions of done.
